title: Toggle Switch Generator
description: Design toggle switches — size, on/off colors, knob — with a working live preview and HTML/CSS.
howto: Set the switch width and on/off colors.
Pick the knob color and an optional label.
Copy the code or download the self-contained toggle.html.

faqs.a: A real checkbox drives it: :checked moves the knob and swaps the track color, with a smooth CSS transition.
Yes — it is a native checkbox with a label, so keyboard and screen readers work.
Height is derived from the width (width ÷ 1.75) so the switch keeps its proportions.

faqs.q: Can I embed it in my page?
faqs.a: Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with tg- to avoid collisions.
